protocol.experiment: Corrected full-dimensional diffusion/FM; same bank and cached structured/GAN models

training.representation: cached normalized aligned functional maps, not weights
training.normalization: logit clamp 1e-4, scalar mean/std fitted to 820 train maps only
training.shared_alignment: unchanged raw-training Hungarian alignment from VAE study
training.field_precision: CUDA BF16 autocast forward; FP32 parameters, optimizer, MSE and integration; target evaluation unchanged TF32 FP32
training.field_lr_schedule: source-heldout ReduceLROnPlateau: factor=.5, patience=5 evaluations, threshold=.001, minimum_lr=1e-6
training.plateau_requires: fixed train and heldout probes; stochastic loss window trend
training.GAN_stability: fixed train/heldout sliced Wasserstein plus critic and generator trends; minimax losses need not decrease to zero
training.checkpoint_selection: source heldout objective only; GAN heldout sliced Wasserstein

sampling.diffusion_objective: DDPM cosine schedule, x0 prediction, unweighted MSE
sampling.flow_objective: independent Gaussian-to-data linear-path conditional flow matching MSE
sampling.canonicalization: Hungarian column match to pooled FUNCTIONAL TRAIN mean only; same for all five generators
sampling.score: mean of all 4 x 32 canonicalized generated maps, then hard top-K
sampling.replicas: one mask repeated over 4 paired target initializations

protocol.comparison_status: exploratory: both old/fresh fixed target task vectors have already been inspected
protocol.comparison_limitation: new generators pool tasks and use sampling mean; existing VAE uses separate models and agreement. FM backbones share objective/data/extraction and batch size, differing capacity.
protocol.adaptive_sparsity: deferred; fixed top-K prevents opening all edges; future selection must use source-only or nested validation

articles.adaptation: full-map x0 DDPM with time/task scalar input residual, no learned VAE/PCA compressor
conditional linear-path field with full-dimensional time/task input residual
small bipartite neural graph edge/node velocity field; not paper reproduction
alignment motivates matched-bank control; no full-weight DeepWeightFlow reproduction
SAB over 32 hidden-neuron columns as equivariant flow field
HyperGAN inspiration only; not its architecture/loss

correction.change: add zero-initialized time/task scalar coefficient times full input map
correction.matched_initialization: base FlatTimeField and initial outputs identical under same training seed
correction.matched_data_noise_schedule: same cached arrays, RNG seeds, batch128, optimizer, source validation probes
correction.reason: unmodified full map output variation rank <=256, cannot represent full-dimensional noise transport
correction.phase1_flat_models_status: architecturally bottlenecked diagnostic controls; not representative diffusion/FM tests
correction.selection: architecture change from source-only rank/loss diagnostics, not target score
